```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && node -e "
const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');
const dir='content/english/blog';
const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.md')&&!f.startsWith('_'));
for (const f of files.sort()) {
  const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,f),'utf8');
  const fm=raw.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---/);
  const draft=/draft:\s*false/.test(fm?.[1]||'');
  const body=raw.replace(/^---[\s\S]*?---\n/,'').replace(/^#.*\n/,'');
  const words=body.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const first400=body.slice(0,400);
  const hasI=/\b(I|I'm|I've|my)\b/.test(first400);
  const cats=(fm?.[1].match(/categories:\s*\[([^\]]+)\]/)?.[1]||'').replace(/[\"']/g,'');
  const opinionLike=/Opinion|Faith|Family|Games|Sports/.test(cats);
  const h2s=(body.match(/^## .+/gm)||[]).length;
  const sections=body.split(/^## /m).slice(1);
  let thin=0;
  for (const s of sections) {
    const text=s.replace(/^[^\n]+\n/,'').trim();
    if (text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length < 40) thin++;
  }
  const issues=[];
  if (draft && opinionLike && !hasI) issues.push('no-I-opener');
  if (thin>=2) issues.push('thin-sections:'+thin);
  if (words<200 && draft) issues.push('short:'+words);
  if (issues.length) console.log((draft?'PUB':'DRAFT')+' '+f+' '+issues.join(','));
}
" 2>&1
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && node -e "
const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');
const yaml=require?null:null;
function parseFm(raw){
  const m=raw.match(/^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---/);
  if(!m) return {};
  const fm={};
  for(const line of m[1].split('\n')){
    const kv=line.match(/^(\w+):\s*(.*)/);
    if(kv) fm[kv[1]]=kv[2].replace(/^[\"']|[\"']$/g,'');
  }
  return fm;
}
const dir='content/english/blog';
const results={pub:[],draft:[]};
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.md')&&x!=='_index.md').sort()) {
  const raw=fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,f),'utf8');
  const fm=parseFm(raw);
  const isDraft=f.startsWith('__')||fm.draft==='true';
  const body=raw.replace(/^---[\s\S]*?---\n/,'').replace(/^# [^\n]+\n/,'');
  const words=body.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  const first400=body.replace(/[#*\[\]()>-]/g,' ').slice(0,400);
  const hasI=/\b(I|I'm|I've|my)\b/.test(first400);
  const cats=fm.categories||'';
  const opinionLike=/Opinion|Faith|Family|Games|Sports/.test(cats);
  const h2s=(body.match(/^## .+/gm)||[]);
  const sections=body.split(/^## /m).slice(1);
  let thin=0, noFailure=0;
  for (const s of sections) {
    const heading=s.split('\n')[0];
    const text=s.replace(/^[^\n]+\n/,'').trim();
    const wc=text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
    if (wc<50) thin++;
    const failure=/wrong|broke|mistake|annoy|skip|drawer|failed|almost|didn't|wouldn't|never|walked past|gave up/i.test(text);
    if (!failure && wc>30) noFailure++;
  }
  const row={f,words,draft:isDraft,hasI,opinionLike,thin,h2:h2s.length,noFailure};
  (isDraft?results.draft:results.pub).push(row);
}
console.log('=== PUBLISHED ('+results.pub.length+') ===');
for (const r of results.pub) {
  const flags=[];
  if (r.opinionLike && !r.hasI) flags.push('no-I-opener');
  if (r.thin>=2) flags.push('thin:'+r.thin);
  if (r.noFailure>=3) flags.push('swap-risk:'+r.noFailure);
  if (r.words>2500) flags.push('long:'+r.words);
  if (flags.length) console.log(r.f.padEnd(42)+' '+flags.join(' '));
}
console.log('\n=== DRAFTS ('+results.draft.length+') outline/short ===');
for (const r of results.draft) {
  const flags=[];
  if (r.words<500) flags.push('short:'+r.words);
  if (r.thin>=2) flags.push('thin:'+r.thin);
  if (r.h2<2 && r.words<800) flags.push('outline');
  if (flags.length) console.log(r.f.padEnd(42)+' '+flags.join(' '));
}
" 2>&1
```

# Blog voice review (jorap-voice)

Reviewed all **77** posts under `content/english/blog/` against the updated skill: automated gates, `slop:score`, structural heuristics (opener, thin sections, swap-test proxy), and spot reads of published posts and drafts.

## Automated gates: clean

| Check | Result |
|--------|--------|
| `pnpm lint:voice` | Pass (dashes + banned words/phrases) |
| `pnpm lint:slop` | Pass (0 publish blockers on blogs) |
| `pnpm slop:score` | All posts **≤ 1.19 per100w** (target ≤ 2.0) |
| Wiki export footers | None |
| `## Bottom line` | None |
| Currency in prose | None |
| `image-template.jpg` on live posts | None |

The archive is in good mechanical shape. What’s left is qualitative: connection, lived-in sections, and draft readiness.

## Cross-cutting findings

**What’s working**

- Openers mostly lead with experience or reader friction, not dictionary defs.
- No AI-tell phrase clusters (`When it comes to`, `Furthermore`, `hope this helps`, etc.) except as intentional warning in `__humanize-ai-articles.md`.
- Opinion posts use “I” early; no `no-first-person-opener` slop warnings on published work.
- Long posts (`open-source`, `apple-strategically-late`, `local-ai`) stay under 1.2 per100w — structure isn’t bloating into slop.

**Gaps vs updated skill**

1. **One failure per H2** — biggest gap on Tier B published posts and the Hugo tutorial cluster. Heuristic flagged swap-risk on ~19 published posts; doesn’t mean rewrite everything, means add one honest friction beat where a section is pure advice.
2. **Connection lens on guides** — `getting-started-with-rss-feeds.md` and `why-keep-desktop-laptop.md` inform well; a single “I got this wrong once” line per major section would push them to connect.
3. **`streamlining-games-and-sports.md`** — voice-ready but `draft: true` without `__` prefix; pick publish or rename to `__` for consistency.
4. **`voice:scan` review words** on `how-i-built-jorap-notes.md`, `hugoplate-theme-review.md`, `mouse-wheel-click.md` — “deploy”, “metadata”, “repository” in technical context; skill allows topic terms. No change required unless you want even plainer synonyms.

2. **Quick scene pass then publish** — password managers, wifi router, smart plug, Hugo tutorial cluster
3. **Light polish on live posts** — `why-keep-desktop-laptop.md`, `getting-started-with-rss-feeds.md` (one failure beat per thin H2)
4. **Expand or shelve** — sub-500-word drafts and recipe-adjacent stubs
